arStrings.szText: Two figures, deathly pale, slashed my partner's throat, mauled our horse…and then drank their blood! They delighted in it! Horrible!

I tried to crawl away, but one saw me. It lunged at me, faster than a demon! I would have died, but the drowned came, and they swarmed over the bloodsucker like crabs on a corpse. I...I'm lucky to be alive.
The second creature managed to escape—I saw it run that way. Please...you must kill it before it hurts anyone else.
